description: C1 shadow-parity corpus for the R2 bootstrap system manifest import intent. Request cases cover a minimal but field-complete ONE_SHOT manifest (application, environment, one APPLICATION_CODE component with an IMMUTABLE_DIGEST revision). Response cases cover the full bootstrap outcome: application/environment/component/edge records, component revisions, topology revision, system version set, bootstrap attestation, bootstrap system assignment and the idempotency delivery, all revision-1 per the legacy record revision constraints. Every expected verdict must be agreed by the generated JSON Schema 2020-12 validators and the legacy Pydantic models (SystemManifestImportRequest / SystemManifestImportResponse).
